'''APIS''' is the fee and utility token of '''MELEK-Engine''', the Hive-Engine-style side-token layer that runs alongside the [[MELEK Blockchain|MELEK]] ecosystem. Its name is the Latin word for ''bee'' — the engine's economy is described with a beehive vocabulary (workers, drones, hash), continuing the same imagery as Hive.

== MELEK-Engine ==
MELEK-Engine is a side-chain-style token layer: it lets tokens be issued and traded on top of the base chain without custom base-chain operations. APIS is the layer's own fee/utility token — the unit that pays for engine actions. See [[Running Tokens on MELEK-Engine]] for how a project issues its own token there.

== How APIS is earned — the WorkerBee mechanic, re-mapped ==
APIS is not premined into circulation; it is mined by staking, on a design re-mapped from Hive-Engine's WorkerBee model:
* '''Forever-lock''' — [[Wrapped Tokens|wMELEK]] (wrapped MELEK bridged onto [[PRANA Blockchain|PRANA]]) can be permanently locked.
* '''APIS-Hash''' — a forever-lock mints '''APIS-Hash''', a non-transferable (soulbound) mining-power unit — the staked-WORKERBEE equivalent.
* '''Drip''' — APIS-Hash then drips APIS continuously, at the holder's stake-weighted share of emission.

Because APIS-Hash is soulbound, mining power cannot be sold on once it is committed; it stays with the account that locked the MELEK.

== Status ==
The engine layer runs on the testnet and bootstraps its APIS genesis there. APIS has no external market at the time of writing — where a live price would appear (for example on the [[Token Price Ticker]]) it is shown honestly as ''n/a'' rather than with an invented number.
